blocks.html: Steel pipe and tube sections used for concrete-filled steel pipe and tube piles shall conform to ASTM A 252 or ASTM A 283. Concrete shall conform to Section 1812.1.1. The maximum coarse aggregate size shall be 3/4 inch (19.1 mm).
